record.title: Recover relevant source-controller contracts from four pinned repositories
record.intent: Replace article-only assumptions with code and stock-binary evidence before another device operation.
requirements: Pin and inspect brycecherry75/MAX2870, gbonacini/sigenmax2870, nuclearrambo/MAX2870-PLL-board and gamozolabs/max2871-siggen. Prioritize the latter's stock dump, board description and custom firmware.

Separate direct synthesizer SPI libraries, host serial clients, original firmware bytes and replacement firmware. Trace command encoding and receive handling where available; do not transfer replacement commands to stock firmware.

Hash the published stock dump and statically investigate relevant UART framing or parser evidence with bounded offline controls where useful. Identify the strongest justified inference about the prior point-command trial, including unresolved build equivalence and LCD semantics.
Inspect backup and programmer code for actual reset, RAM execution, flash and option-byte effects. Assess the offered ST-Link/J-Link as available tools, not authorization to attach or run them.
Keep acquired repositories and supplied screenshot private. Publish pinned provenance and a concise code-level comparison; execute no upstream scripts and perform no physical operation.
acceptance: A pinned code review distinguishes reusable contracts from unverified board equivalence and identifies concrete next evidence.
